standard_prerequisites.name: The right orthogonal of an object is stable under the triangulated subcategory it generates
standard_prerequisites.use: Extends the Hom vanishing from E to every object of the subcategory generated by E.

standard_prerequisites.name: On projective space the twists O_X(-m) for m >= n + 1 lie in the subcategory generated by E, being quasi-isomorphic to finite complexes built from summands of E, by the resolution lemma for projective space
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the negative twists as test objects.

standard_prerequisites.name: For an ample invertible module, an object whose twisted cohomology groups against all powers vanish must be zero, by the ampleness detection lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes K = 0 from the vanishing of the Hom groups.

core_obligations: Assume K in D_QCoh(O_X) with Hom(E, K[p]) = 0 for all p; by the right-orthogonal lemma Hom(E', K[p]) = 0 for all E' in the subcategory generated by E (proof lines 4386-4389).

Build the negative twists: the construct-the-next-one lemma with a = -n-1 exhibits O_X(-n-1) as a finite complex of sums of summands of E, hence in the generated subcategory; repeating with a = -n-2 and inducting gives O_X(-m) in the generated subcategory for all m >= 0 (proof lines 4390-4396).

Conclude: Hom(O_X(-m), K[p]) = H^p(X, K tensor^L O_X(m)) = H^p(X, K tensor^L O_X(1)^{tensor m}) vanishes for all m, p by the first step; since O_X(1) is ample on projective space, the nonzero-some-cohomology lemma forces K = 0 (proof lines 4398-4409).
proof_roadmap: Close the Hom vanishing under the generated subcategory (proof lines 4386-4389).
Produce all negative twists of the structure sheaf inside it (proof lines 4390-4396).
Detect K = 0 by ampleness through the twisted cohomology groups (proof lines 4398-4409).
